newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks to see adjustment after Wall St falls.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks to see adjustment after Wall St falls.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are likely to see some adjustment on Thursday, following three days of gains, as a decline in Wall Street stocks overnight may make participants cautious in Tokyo, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the 225-share Nikkei average ended 48.40 points or 0.24 percent higher at 20,611.56. Its June futures shed 10 points to close at 20,550.
"The trend is still upward, but people could become cautious this morning after U.S. stocks declined," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager of equities operations group, Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
On Wednesday, the Dow industrials dipped 42.49 points to close at 7,269.66. Technology stocks led the decline, extending their slump.

"We have seen good cyclical buying in issues backed by strong earnings. But the Nikkei 225 has continued to climb without a pause, so the market may see some consolidation," said a senior broker at a "Big Four" brokerage house.
